lead.event: GoTo reports Q3 2026 profit and raises its adjusted EBITDA target
lead.headline: GOTO reports Rp441 billion Q3 profit, lifts 2026 EBITDA target to Rp3.5–3.7 trillion
lead.blurb: GoTo reported Q3 net profit of Rp441 billion, reversing a Rp255 billion loss a year earlier and marking its third consecutive profitable quarter. It raised its 2026 adjusted group EBITDA target to Rp3.5–3.7 trillion from Rp3.2–3.4 trillion, citing fintech outperformance and renewed growth in on-demand services. Adjusted group EBITDA rose 84% year on year to Rp950 billion, while net revenue increased 17% to Rp5.6 trillion. GoTo also raised its fintech target to Rp1.9–2.0 trillion and its On-Demand Services target to Rp1.4–1.6 trillion.

other.event: Energi Mega Persada shares hit auto-reject limits for three consecutive sessions
other.headline: ENRG hits lower price limit for three consecutive sessions
other.blurb: Energi Mega Persada was locked at Rp665 from 27 to 29 October. Net sales for the period ended 30 September rose to USD426.06 million from USD361.38 million a year earlier. The company plans to complete its USD200 million acquisition of HighPeak Energy by year-end.

earnings_guidance.event: BNI reports nine-month 2026 profit growth as shares rebound
earnings_guidance.headline: BBNI reports 6.6% nine-month profit growth as shares rebound
earnings_guidance.blurb: BNI reported nine-month net profit of Rp16.1 trillion, up 6.6% annually, as loans grew 22.2% to Rp992.5 trillion. Shares rebounded to Rp3,240 at the 29 October close from around Rp2,800 in mid-October. Mirae Asset analyst Nafan Aji sees fundamentals supporting a re-rating but flags foreign flows and MSCI policy.

earnings_guidance.event: CIMB Niaga reports nine-month 2026 pre-tax profit of Rp5.8 trillion
earnings_guidance.headline: BNGA reports Rp5.8 trillion pre-tax profit for nine months
earnings_guidance.blurb: CIMB Niaga's loans grew 6.7% year on year to Rp242.6 trillion, led by corporate banking's 15.1% rise. Earnings per share were Rp178.65, while profitability remained pressured by narrowing margins and prudent provisioning.

earnings_guidance.event: Vale Indonesia reports sharply higher nine-month 2026 profit
earnings_guidance.headline: INCO reports nine-month profit up 180.55% to US$147 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Vale Indonesia's nine-month revenue rose 27% to US$896 million, while Q3 profit was US$43 million. The company attributed Q3 revenue support to higher nickel matte shipments and nickel ore sales from Bahodopi and Pomalaa.

earnings_guidance.event: Bukit Asam reports nine-month 2026 net profit of Rp4.41 trillion
earnings_guidance.headline: PTBA reports nine-month 2026 net profit of Rp4.41 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bukit Asam's revenue rose 12% year-on-year to Rp35.20 trillion as an 18% increase in average selling price offset a 4% decline in sales volume. EBITDA was Rp7.19 trillion, with a 13% net profit margin and a 20% EBITDA margin.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: GoTo reports progress on its ongoing share-buyback program
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: GOTO reports Rp985 billion in ongoing share buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: GoTo had repurchased 36 billion shares, nearly 3% of its total, as of 29 October, with Rp2.5 trillion still allocated through June 2027. It will also cancel 32 billion treasury shares, or 2.7% of total shares, with cancellation expected in 2–3 months.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: GoTo plans to cancel 32 billion treasury shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: GOTO plans to cancel 32 billion treasury shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Shareholders approved the move on 14 October. The shares equal about 2.7% of total shares, and cancellation is expected within two to three months after regulatory processes are completed. As of 29 October, GoTo had spent Rp985 billion buying back 36 billion shares, with Rp2.5 trillion allocated for the program through June 2027.
